events.title: You Must Peg Demo Update v0.1.4
events.summary: New Large card preview option! Hover any card and a much larger copy appears in a dock at the right edge of the screen!The Carnival's programmer art is replaced with actual dynamic visuals now, give it a whirl!Additional art for some offerings.Changed Selling items during pack openings works correctly, now you can swap out your junk for that perfect roll you got.FixedVarious minor bugfixes.
